name: K Pharma,Inc.
summary: K Pharma, Inc., headquartered in Minato, Japan, and formed in 2016, researches, develops, produces and sells regenerative medicines and pharmaceutical products in Japan. Its regenerative medicine work relies on iPS cells (induced pluripotent stem cells) specific to particular diseases, and is aimed mainly at conditions such as cerebral infarction and injuries to the spinal cord.
